proposals.evidence: Turner laghu documents the metathesized halk-/haḷk- light family, including Kotgarhi hɔḷkɔ, Marathi haḷkā and regional haluko/halukā. These survey forms are compared with the same family, retaining loss of initial h and local extensions where present. Turner also notes Hindi/Punjabi diffusion into western languages; this family-level link leaves the precise regional route open.
